200g silken tofu, room temp

200g cooking chocolate, melted and allowed to cool a bit

2 tbsp of caster sugar (more if you have a sweet tooth)

Put the silken tofu into a food processor or the beaker that comes with a stick blender and give it a whizz until its smooth, add the sugar and another quick whizz to mix the sugar through. Add the melted, slightly cooled chocolate and whizz again until the colour is even. Spoon or pipe into small ramekins and refrigerate until ready to eat. You can top these with whipped cream if you are feeling indulgent.
